scope: Models specifically used for normalization or alignment; extraction models are distinguished.

sources.title: Extract, Define, Canonicalize: An LLM-based Framework for Knowledge Graph Construction
sources.evidence: Section 4.1 EDC Models: GPT-4, GPT-3.5-turbo and Mistral-7b are compared for OIE. Remaining prompted components use GPT-3.5-turbo; canonicalization vector similarity uses unmodified E5-Mistral-7b. Appendix A.2: top-5 candidate relations for canonicalization.
sources.limitation: Experiments focus on relation schema canonicalization, not our six-class scientific node-pair task.

sources.title: OntoAligner: A Comprehensive Modular and Robust Python Toolkit for Ontology Alignment
sources.evidence: Table 4: MI-MatOnto uses Mistral-7B-v0.3 (BERT retrieval), P65.3 R33.7 F1 44.5; MI-EMMO uses Qwen2-0.5B (BERT retrieval), P88.4 R96.8 F1 92.4.
sources.limitation: Different ontology datasets and gold alignments; F1 cannot be transferred to the current task or used as an overall model ranking.

sources.title: GraphAgents: Knowledge Graph-Guided Agentic AI for Cross-Domain Materials Design
sources.evidence: Section 4.2: nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5. Section 4.5.2: cross-paper node alignment and merge when cosine similarity exceeds 0.95.
sources.limitation: Embedding threshold merging is not full-source six-class adjudication. Do not describe graph-construction LLM as the normalization judge.
